title: Baked Chicken Spaghetti
changes_from_base: A baked casserole: spaghetti is tossed with poached chicken, a creamy vegetable and tomato sauce and Cheddar, then baked until bubbling.
summary: A creamy, cheesy baked spaghetti with poached chicken, soft vegetables and tomatoes with green chilli, baked until golden and bubbling.
equipment: large frying pan or sauté pan

ingredients.item: fine salt for 3 litres of pasta water (0.8%)
ingredients.note: about 4 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

ingredients.item: unsalted butter, plus extra for the dish
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Poach the chicken
steps.text: Cover the breasts with cold water in the saucepan, add the bay leaf and bring to a bare simmer. Cook 12-15 min until the thickest part reads 74 °C, then lift out, cool a little and shred. Gentle heat keeps the meat moist.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Set it to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and butter the baking dish.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in 3 litres salted water for about 2 min less than the packet time, as it finishes in the oven. Drain and tip into the mixing bowl.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.text: Melt the butter in the frying pan over medium heat and cook the onion, mushrooms, celery and green pepper for 10-12 min until soft. Add the garlic for the last 2 min.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Stir in the flour and cook 2 min until it smells nutty. Add the milk a splash at a time, stirring out lumps, then the stock, onion and garlic powders, salt and pepper. Simmer 5 min until thick, then stir in the tomatoes and chilli.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add the sauce, chicken, half the Cheddar and all the Parmesan to the pasta and mix well. Spread in the dish and scatter over the rest of the Cheddar.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake uncovered for about 35 min, until bubbling at the edges and golden on top. Rest 5 min before serving.

tips: Undercook the pasta at the boiling stage; it keeps softening in the oven.
Leftover roast chicken works too; use about 450 g meat.
Add a dash of hot sauce at the table if you like more heat.
storage: Cool, cover and refrigerate within 2 hours for up to 3 days, or freeze portions for up to 2 months. Reheat covered in a 180 °C oven until piping hot (74 °C).
